name: DEV.to Search
label: DEV.to (Forem) - Tech Community Articles
description: Browse and filter public DEV.to articles via the Forem REST API (https://dev.to/api). v0 is deprecated; v1 is current and requires Accept: application/vnd.forem.api-v1+json (https://developers.forem.com/api). This node's Java handler still omits that Accept header (out of this node's spec; no api_spec.json). No authentication is required for public list endpoints. Optional instance config api_key is sent as the Forem header `api-key` (not Authorization / Bearer) to raise rate limits; the key is never logged or returned. EXACT actions (case-sensitive, lowercase): 'articles' | 'latest'. 'articles' (default) is GET https://dev.to/api/articles with tag/tags/tags_exclude/username/top/state/collection_id filters. 'latest' is GET https://dev.to/api/articles/latest (recency only; tag filters are ignored). User-Agent is always StudioQuack/1.0. Needs outbound internet egress to dev.to. Failures are returned as output.error inside the output object — this node has no error OUTPUT port.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Single object of Forem search parameters. The daemon delivers this as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList[] with targetPortValue=input). No field is required: action defaults to 'articles'. Optional fields: action, tag, tags, tags_exclude, username, top, per_page, page, state, collection_id. Tag/state pairing follows Forem v0 (see each field). Do not put api_key here — it is instance config. Example: {"action":"articles","tag":"python","top":7,"per_page":10}.

schema.label: action
schema.description: Which Forem list to fetch. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive, lowercase): 'articles' | 'latest'. 'articles' (default when omitted or blank) GET https://dev.to/api/articles and applies tag/tags/tags_exclude/username/top/state/collection_id. 'latest' GET https://dev.to/api/articles/latest and ignores all tag/username/top/state/collection filters (only page + per_page). Any other string fails with output.error 'Unknown action: {action}. Use articles or latest.' Example: 'articles'.

schema.label: tag
schema.description: Tag filter for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). Normalization: split on commas, whitespace, or plus ([,\s+]+), lowercase, strip, drop empties. One remaining slug is sent as Forem query param `tag` (the single-tag param that combines with `top`). Two or more slugs are sent as `tags` joined with ', ' instead. Ignored entirely when `tags` is also present (`tags` wins even if it normalizes empty). Example: 'python' or 'machine-learning'.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Multi-tag filter for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). When present, normalized slugs are sent as Forem query param `tags` (joined with ', ') and the `tag` field is not sent. Same normalization as `tag` (split on commas, whitespace, or plus; lowercase). Use this for an explicit multi-tag search. Example: 'ai, python' or 'machine-learning+nlp' → tags=ai, python.

schema.label: tags_exclude
schema.description: Tags to exclude for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). Normalized like `tags` and sent as Forem `tags_exclude` when at least one slug remains after split/lowercase/strip. Empty/blank is omitted. Example: 'discuss, watercooler'.

schema.label: username
schema.description: Forem author username for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). Sent as query param `username`. Forem rule: `state` is combinable ONLY with `username` — if `state` is set and this field is omitted, `state` is skipped (avoids a Forem 404) and a helper warning is logged. Combinable with tag/tags. Example: 'ben'.

schema.label: top
schema.description: Most-popular window in days for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). When present and truthy (non-zero / non-empty), sent as integer Forem param `top` (articles with the most reactions in the last N days). Combinable with `tag` / `tags`. Forem does not combine `top` with `state` — do not set both. Omitted when missing or 0. Example: 7 for the past week.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size. Default: instance config default_per_page (30). action='articles' (GET /api/articles) caps at 1000; action='latest' (GET /api/articles/latest) caps at 100. The handler sends min(per_page, that cap). Values above the cap are truncated, not rejected. Example: 30.

schema.label: page
schema.description: 1-based page index sent on both actions. Default: 1 when omitted or blank. Combine with per_page to walk results. Example: 1.

schema.label: state
schema.description: Forem article state for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). EXACT accepted values: 'fresh' | 'rising' | 'all'. 'fresh' = recent with few reactions; 'rising' = gaining traction; 'all' = no extra state filter on that author's articles. Forem rule: combinable ONLY with `username`. If `username` is missing, this field is NOT sent (prevents Forem 404) and a warning is logged. Do not pair with `top`. Example: 'rising'.

schema.label: collection_id
schema.description: Forem series/collection id for action='articles' only (ignored on 'latest'). When present and truthy, sent as integer query param `collection_id`. Omitted when missing or 0. Example: 12345.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object on the output port. Success shape: {status:'ok', articles_returned, articles}. Article objects from 'articles' include canonical_url, reading_time_minutes, author_username; 'latest' omits those three fields. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Operation status. EXACT value 'ok' on success. Absent when the payload is a failure object that only contains error. Do not treat a missing status as success. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Articles Returned
schema.description: Count of objects in articles[] for this page (not a site-wide total). Integer. Present on success; absent on failure. Equals articles.length. Example: 10.

schema.label: Articles
schema.description: Page of mapped article objects. action='articles' each object: id, title, description, url, canonical_url, published_at, positive_reactions_count, comments_count, reading_time_minutes, tag_list (list), author_name (user.name), author_username (user.username). action='latest' omits canonical_url, reading_time_minutes, author_username (same as the Python node). Missing strings default to '' and missing counts to 0. tag_list is copied from Forem (usually a string array). Empty array when Forem returned []. Present on success.

configurationParameters.label: API Key
configurationParameters.description: Optional Forem / DEV.to API key from https://dev.to/settings/extensions (Generate API Key). When non-blank, sent on every request as header `api-key` (literal header name — not Authorization, not Bearer). Public list endpoints work with this empty; a key raises rate limits. Never logged, never copied onto output, never placed in query strings. Leave empty for unauthenticated public access. Type: string.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for each Forem GET (request timeout on the shared client). Default: 25 when omitted or blank. A non-positive value is treated as 25 by the HTTP helper. Keep this at or below the daemon stateful request budget (typically 300s) or the daemon fails the node first. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Default Per Page
configurationParameters.description: Default page size used when input.per_page is omitted. Default: 30. This is not the API cap: action='articles' still sends min(n, 1000); action='latest' still sends min(n, 100). Example: 30.
